TaskDescription: Constrained single-saccade visual comparison (Go/No-Go) task on a bi-resolution gaze-contingent display with parametrically manipulated temporal delays (0, 100, 300, 1000 ms) and spatial-temporal incongruency, followed by a subjective authorship report after each 16 s task block.
Instructions: Fixate on the central Chinese character, make a single saccade to one of four peripheral characters at trial onset, maintain fixation until trial end, and press the Go button only if the central and peripheral characters match. During the post-block report period, indicate whether the high-resolution window update was self-initiated (no delay), self-initiated but delayed, or controlled by the computer.
